name: 古尔巴
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:398
who: Gulba, a half-orc quarryman's son of the river valley, looking twenty-nine: about 205 cm, tall and very broad, a mountain of a man with big thick hands, knuckles callused. Grey-green skin, two short tusk tips just showing past the lower lip, black hair shaved very short with a layer of white stone dust on the scalp, slow amber eyes that take a long look at people. In his right hand a straight, smooth stone staff taller than himself, ground from the hardest white stone in the valley by his father; it is perfectly straight, with no bend in it yet. At his belt a straw pouch from which small woven straw goats poke out. One word at a time, heavy and kind.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, calm grey-green face of a man in his late twenties, slow amber eyes, two small tusk tips just showing, a heavy brow, a gentle closed mouth.
build: 205 cm, very tall and broad, huge shoulders and thick arms, a heavy, steady stance.
palette: grey-green and stone grey, amber, white stone dust, straw yellow, dull earth brown
casual: His quarryman's clothes: a heavy leather apron scored all over with chisel marks, worn over a rough undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, wide trousers and heavy boots; a straw pouch at his belt with small woven straw goats poking out; in his right hand the tall straight white stone staff. White dust on his hair and forearms. He stands with his shoulders slightly down, a slow, patient look.
private: Off work: a loose long-sleeved linen shirt, wide trousers, bare feet, no apron; a small woven straw goat held in his big fingers and the stone staff in his other hand. He stands relaxed, a gentle look.
battle: Bracing for a rockfall: the scored leather apron laced tight over a leather jerkin, leather bracers, the straight white stone staff held upright in front of him with both hands, the shoulders squared, feet planted wide, a steady, heavy look.
formal: A long undyed wool coat with a woven straw sash, the scored apron folded over one arm, the straw pouch at his belt, the stone staff held upright in his right hand. He stands very still, a calm, kind look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the slow amber eyes looking straight at the viewer with a gentle, patient look. Warm earth-yellow light from one side, fine white stone dust drifting in it. Foreground blur: a small woven straw goat held toward the viewer. He wears the scored leather apron.

name: 玛格达
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:454
who: Magda, a dwarf woman, a mountain blaster of the Roaring Cliffs forges, looking about thirty: about 136 cm, short and sturdy, broad strong shoulders and a thick waist. A fiery red mane braided into two thick braids, the ends wound with copper wire. Copper-green eyes that squint to a slit when she is calculating. A few small scars from sparks across her cheeks, her eyebrows burned off once and grown back thin and sparse by half. Short thick fingers with black red-powder under the nails. A brisk, hard-working, quick-witted air.
face: FACE: a grown woman's face, a dwarf of about thirty, with a firm round jaw, copper-green eyes, thin sparse eyebrows and a few tiny spark-burn scars on the cheeks; NOT a child's face.
build: 136 cm, short and sturdy: broad strong shoulders and back, a C-cup, a thick waist and strong rounded hips. Packed with muscle.
palette: fire red, copper and verdigris green, soot black, scorched brown leather, a little red-powder rust
casual: Her blasting-work clothes: a thick leather work suit with sleeves scorched in several places, the cuffs singed; on her back a flat iron case with compartments holding copper tubes and red powder; at her belt a small chisel, a coil of fuse cord and a wax tablet for reckoning. Thick boots. Her red braids with copper wire hang over her shoulders. A sharp, narrow-eyed look.
private: Off work: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt and a heavy wool skirt to the shins, thick stockings and house boots, the braids loose over one shoulder; the wax tablet held in one hand and a stylus in the other. She stands easy, a tired, content look.
battle: The scorched leather work suit with a leather apron and a wide belt, thick gloves, a stout hammered-iron helmet, the iron case on her back, a copper tube of red powder held in one hand and a coil of fuse in the other, feet planted wide, eyes narrowed to slits.
formal: A neat dark red wool dress with long sleeves and a high collar, a broad leather belt studded with copper, her red braids freshly wound with bright copper wire, the small chisel worn as a brooch. She stands square with her hands on her belt, a proud, grinning look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the copper-green eyes narrowed to a slit as if calculating, a sly corner of a smile, the red braids with copper wire in front of her shoulders. Hot orange forge light from one side, cool grey cliff shadow behind. Foreground blur: drifting red sparks and a copper tube. She wears the scorched leather work suit.

name: 莉泽
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:510
who: Liese, a human miller's daughter of the lower river, a water-finder, sixteen: about 158 cm, small and slender frame, light and quick, wholly covered by her clothes. Flax-coloured hair tied in one high ponytail that swings when she runs. A row of freckles across the bridge of her nose with a dab of river mud on the tip. Wide water-blue eyes that open very wide when she looks at the ground. Her feet are often bare, the soles white with riverbed clay. A restless, bright, curious air. Not wearing glasses, no jewellery.
palette: flax gold, water blue, flour white, riverbed clay grey-white, soft brown
casual: Her miller's-family clothes: a plain coarse linen blouse with the sleeves dusted with flour, a brown wool skirt down to the ankles, a rope marked with a knot every handspan tied at her waist for measuring water, bare feet white with clay; in her right hand a forked willow stick for dowsing. A bright, wide-eyed look.
private: A long-sleeved cream linen dress to the shins, wool stockings, soft house shoes, the ponytail loosened over one shoulder; a wooden ladle in one hand. She stands relaxed, a curious look, eyes open and mouth closed.
battle: The linen blouse under a short leather vest, the brown skirt over close-fitting wool leggings, laced leather boots, the measuring rope across her chest, the forked willow stick held out in front with both hands; wide eyes, closed mouth, serious.
formal: A clean pale blue linen dress with long sleeves and a white collar, a green ribbon tied around the flax ponytail, the measuring rope coiled and tucked into the sash, laced shoes. She stands with the hands folded, a shy, bright closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the water-blue eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer with open curiosity, the mouth closed, the high flax ponytail swinging into the frame. Cool morning light from one side. Foreground blur: drops of river water and a few flour specks. She wears the flour-dusted linen blouse.

name: 瑞恩·无名
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:576
who: Ryan, a human former mine slave of the deepest level of the Blackstone royal mine, known only by his number, looking thirty-one: about 178 cm, lean and tight-muscled with thick forearms and broad shoulders. Skin pale as one who has not seen the sun, black hair shaved by the mine and grown back in short uneven stubble, dark eyes that squint in daylight. On his left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us) a very coarse iron shackle, locked, its inner side worn bright by years of rubbing. At his belt a small oil lamp whose oil is never allowed to run dry. A few words only, a heavy, sleepless air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, pale man of about thirty with the eyes of someone who has watched too long, squinting a little, dark brows, a closed hard mouth; no beard.
build: 178 cm, lean and wiry with thick forearms, heavy shoulders and a mine-worker's tight frame.
palette: pale ash and soot black, iron grey, lamp-flame amber, dull rust
casual: His mine clothes: a torn coarse hemp shirt and trousers, the knees and elbows worn through; on the left wrist the heavy locked iron shackle; at his belt the small oil lamp; in his right hand a worn miner's hammer with three finger-notches knocked out of the handle. He stands with his shoulders low, a wary, squinting look.
private: A patched long-sleeved hemp shirt, rolled trousers, boots, the shackle still on the left wrist, the small lit lamp held in his right hand. He stands with his shoulders low, a heavy, sleepless look.
battle: The torn hemp shirt under a thick leather apron laced tight, the lamp hooked on his belt, the miner's hammer swung back in both hands. Feet planted wide, a fierce, silent look.
formal: A clean dark-grey wool tunic-coat open at the neck and tied with a leather cord over the hemp shirt, the shackle still on the left wrist, its iron faintly warm with an ore glow, the small lit lamp at his belt, the hammer held in one hand. He stands very still, a heavy, blank look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes narrowed against the light, looking at the viewer with a heavy, silent look. Warm lamp-flame light from the side below, cold dark behind. Foreground blur: the heavy iron shackle chain and the small lit lamp. He wears the torn hemp shirt.

name: 埃贡
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:632
who: Egon, a human gate guard of the Blackstone royal city, the outermost of the seven gates, twenty-six: about 188 cm, tall and broad with a thick back. A square, clean-shaven face with no beard, no goatee and no stubble anywhere on it; across the point of the chin run two or three short thin PALE scar lines, pink-white and lighter than the skin around them, lying side by side, left by a bronze-hide wolf's claws when he was riding heavy cavalry. Sandy-gold hair cut very short, steel-blue eyes that look at a person's hands first. Palms thick with calluses from reins and spear shafts. A steady, stubborn, unmoving air. The short old claw scar sits right ON the point of the chin, two or three thin pale parallel lines running across it, clearly drawn in every panel and in the portrait; it is on the chin itself, not on the neck or the jaw. These chin scars are drawn as pale marks lighter than the skin, never as dark strokes and never as hair: there is no chin tuft, no goatee, no stubble on the chin in any panel or expression.
build: 188 cm, tall and broad with a thick back and shoulders strong enough to push half a city gate open alone.
palette: sandy gold, steel blue, bronze and brown, dull iron, a little black
casual: His gate-guard uniform: bronze-hide armor, scales cut from bronze-hide wolf skin, with a seven-ringed wall branded on the chest, over a thick brown wool tunic, leather bracers and heavy boots; in his right hand a long spear; at his belt the huge iron key of his gate, as long as his forearm. A broad-set, watchful look.
private: Off watch: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, brown trousers, soft boots, no armor; the long iron key held in one hand and a rag in the other. He stands relaxed, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Heavy-cavalry order: the bronze-hide armor with its seven-ringed brand, a bronze-hide helmet with a nose guard, leather gauntlets, the long spear held low and level in both hands, the iron key tucked at his belt; feet planted, a hard, steady look.
formal: The bronze-hide armor polished, a blue-black wool cloak clasped at the shoulders, the spear held upright beside him, the key on a leather strap across his chest. He stands very straight, an expressionless look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the steel-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a steady, assessing look, the scar on his chin catching the light. Warm sandy-gold light from one side, cold stone gate behind. Foreground blur: a blurred spear shaft and drifting dust. He wears the bronze-hide armor.

name: 梅琳
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:688
who: Merlin, a human ore-sorter from the Thousand Lakes at the mouth of the royal mine, twenty-two: about 160 cm, thin and wiry, medium height. Black hair with a deep blue sheen, braided into one thick plait with a faded red satin ribbon braided into it, the one thing she brought from the lakes. A round face with both cheeks reddened by the pit-mouth wind. Lake-green eyes that read a face as if checking it against a name. Fingers scratched in lines by broken stone. Hanging at her waist an open iron shackle that Ryan smashed free at the pit mouth; she did not throw it away. A gentle, observant air.
build: 160 cm, thin and wiry, narrow shoulders but a strong back, a B-cup, a slim waist and narrow hips.
palette: blue-black and lake green, faded red ribbon, ore-dust grey, rust brown
casual: Her ore-sorter's clothes: a torn coarse hemp shirt and long skirt patched at the knee, a sorting bag tied around the waist, at the hip the broken iron shackle hanging by its chain; the black braid with the faded red satin ribbon over one shoulder. Scratched hands held loosely in front. A soft, attentive look.
private: A patched long-sleeved cream hemp dress to the shins, wool stockings, house shoes, the plait over one shoulder; the faded red ribbon end held between her fingers. She stands quietly, a distant look.
battle: The hemp shirt and skirt under a short leather jacket, close-fitting hemp leggings, laced boots, the heavy sorting bag across her chest, the broken shackle hanging at her waist; a short miner's pick held low in her right hand, steady eyes.
formal: A clean undyed linen dress with long sleeves and a high collar, the black plait newly tied with the faded red ribbon, a small miner's lamp badge pinned at the chest, the broken shackle still at her waist. She stands upright, hands folded, a grave, gentle look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the lake-green eyes looking at the viewer as if learning the name behind the face, a soft closed-mouth smile. Cold lamp-light from the left, warm ore-dust glow behind. Foreground blur: a faded red ribbon and drifting stone dust. She wears the patched hemp shirt, the black plait with the red ribbon over her shoulder.

name: 灰须公爵
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_六_夜祷.md:936
who: The oldest duke of Blackstone, called Greybeard, in his eighties: about 186 cm, thin and tall, a slight stoop, hands that tremble. A long grey-white beard hanging to the middle of his chest and thin white hair combed back. Pale ice-blue eyes that count before they look. A dark-grey Blackstone wool robe; across his chest a chain of heavy silver coins, each one full weight. In his right hand a walking cane made from the leg bone of a bronze-hide wolf. A courteous, calculating air; every sentence he speaks keeps a way out for himself.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old man's face, thin, deep lines at the eyes and mouth, pale ice-blue eyes, white eyebrows, a long white beard; keep the same flat anime style.
build: 186 cm, thin and tall, narrow stooped shoulders.
palette: charcoal grey, silver, bone white, ice blue, dull bronze
casual: His everyday court dress: a long dark-grey wool robe closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a chain of heavy silver coins hanging on the chest, a soft black cap, leather shoes; in his right hand the walking cane of bronze-hide wolf leg bone. His hand trembles slightly on it.
private: A loose long-sleeved dark-grey wool house robe tied with a cord, a woollen shawl over the shoulders, soft slippers, no chain; the cane in his right hand. He stands, a tired, watchful look.
battle: A dark-grey travelling cloak with a fur-lined collar over the court robe, the silver coin chain, one hand gripping the cane like a staff of command, the other raised to point; he carries no weapon. A stern, commanding look.
battle_pose: 3) the commanding outfit: standing very upright for once, the cane raised in one hand and the other pointing ahead, the chin lifted, a hard calculating look; he carries no weapon.
formal: A long black Blackstone velvet robe edged with silver thread, the heavy silver coin chain in several loops, a black cap with a small silver pin, the cane held in both hands before him. He bows slightly, the face smooth and polite.
art: A portrait, the face turned a little aside, the pale ice-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a polite smile that has already counted the cost, the long grey-white beard on his chest. Cold silver light from one side. Foreground blur: the heavy silver coins of his chain. He wears the dark-grey wool robe.
